# Unregistered zs Components Trigger Vue Warning
Unregistered `zs-button-group` and `zs-attachment` components triggered Vue unknown custom component warnings in the 苏州市房地产监测V3 project.

## Description
- `zs-button-group` and `zs-attachment` were not registered, causing Vue warnings.
- Project: 苏州市房地产监测V3 (zhi2-web-admin).

## Root Cause
- Global usage of `<zs-button-group>` in 16 files (e.g., chooseHouseDialog.vue) caused warnings.
- `<zs-attachment>` in contract/index.vue lacked registration.

## Fix
- Replace all `<zs-button-group>` with `<el-button-group>` across 16 files.
- In contract/index.vue, change `<zs-attachment>` to locally imported `attachmentDraw` with `:id` and `:bus` props.

- Source session: da4d6410-f867-47a9-acf7-3468a014ca81

# Table Column Link Failure Due to Refactor
A refactor of `zs-table-column.vue` caused table link buttons to fail due to attribute passthrough conflict and incorrect type detection.

## Description
- `zs-table-column.vue` passed `index`/`function` to `el-table-column`, conflicting with native props.
- Custom `type="link"` detection via `scope.column.type` failed.

## Root Cause
- Passthrough of `index` and `function` broke native `el-table-column` attributes.
- Using `scope.column.type` instead of `$attrs.type` made `type="link"` invisible.

## Fix
- Intercept passthrough for non-`type="index"` columns.
- Use `$attrs.type` to detect custom link type, supporting both `:index="handler"` old and `type="link" :function` new usages.
